messages:
alex.ops: FYI — customers pinging support: 'didn't get a page for high-latency window'. alerting shows triggers, but outgoing page count is zero for the group in the last 10m.
incident-bot: Automated note: Alert PROD-HIGH-LATENCY triggered at 2024-04-10T15:02Z. Delivery attempt flagged as 'shadow-mode' for route=paging-multiplexor-2. No external page sent.
maria-oncall: I'm oncall — I didn't get any page or SMS. checking mobile now.
raj.eng: Looking at notify logs: we see inbound event -> routed to paging-mux -> decision: deliver=false. Header present: X-Notify-Mode=shadow. That seems wrong; config deploy rolled out 14m ago.
serena-sre: Wait, shadow mode was supposed to be a deploy-only mirror. Did the rollout flip the env var globally? @raj can you grep the rollout tag?
raj.eng: quick log snippet:
```
2024-04-10T15:01:38Z | event_id=abc123 | route=paging-mux | X-Notify-Mode=shadow | decision=drop | policy=shadow-mirroring
2024-04-10T15:02:05Z | event_id=abc124 | route=paging-mux | X-Notify-Mode=active  | decision=deliver | policy=default
```
huh — some requests still active, others shadowed. looks like header parsing fell back to default when header absent.
ben-support: Customers impacted: two enterprise tenants reported no page; they manually escalated. Support created incident records INC-786 and INC-787.
alex.ops: Can we hotfix to force deliver for prod routes while we root cause? Manual override in paging-mux to treat shadow as active for tenant-prod.
serena-sre: I'll flip the gating flag on the mux (shadow_opt_in=false) — applying in prod now. Will monitor.
incident-bot: Change applied: shadow_opt_in=false on paging-multiplexor-2 by serena-sre. Re-evaluating pending events.
raj.eng: After flip, outgoing page count rose. Example:
```
2024-04-10T15:04:10Z | event_id=abc129 | route=paging-mux | X-Notify-Mode=shadow | override=force-deliver | decision=deliver
```
maria-oncall: Got a test page. 👍
ben-support: I'll notify affected customers and update the two INC tickets with mitigation steps and ETA for RCA.
alex.ops: Thanks. Next steps: raj + serena to dig why header was interpreted as shadow for some tenants (config propagation or header rewrite at edge?). Also add watcher to ensure page counts don't drop below threshold.
serena-sre: Initial hypothesis: partial deploy to the canary pool set header rewrite plugin incorrectly. I'll trace deploy job and CDN edge plugin versions.
raj.eng: Will grep edge proxies for 'X-Notify-Mode' rewrites; also pulling router metrics to see correlation with deploy windows.
maria-oncall: Closing loop: pages restored, customers informed. Keep channel for RCA updates.
